en: to make somebody/yourself popular
ex: Their policies on taxation didn't endear them to voters.
他们的税收政策并没使他们受到选民的欢迎。

zh: 令人爱慕的；惹人喜爱的；讨人喜欢的
en: causing people to feel love
ex: an endearing habit
讨人喜欢的习惯

zh: in a way that causes people to feel love
en: in a way that causes people to feel love
ex: an endearingly old-fashioned idea
可爱的老式想法

zh: 表示爱慕的话语；亲热的表示
en: a word or an expression that is used to show love
ex: They were whispering endearments to each other.
他们彼此低声倾吐着爱慕之情。

zh: （尤指新的或艰苦的）努力，尝试
en: an attempt to do something, especially something new or difficult
ex: There have been great advances in the field of scientific endeavour.
在科学探索领域已经取得了巨大的进步。

zh: 地方性的；（某地或某集体中）特有的，流行的，难摆脱的
en: regularly found in a particular place or among a particular group of people and difficult to get rid of
ex: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.
疟疾是许多气候炎热国家的流行病。

en: the final stage of a game of chess
ex: Both sides in these negotiations realize that the endgame is now being played out.
在这些谈判中，双方都意识到最终的局面正在酝酿之中。

en: the last part of a story, film, etc.
ex: His stories usually have a happy ending.
他的故事通常有一个美满的结局。

zh: 菊苣（根干燥后可与咖啡同饮或作其代用品）
en: a plant with green curly leaves that are eaten raw as a vegetable

zh: 无止境的；无垠的；无穷无尽的；不计其数的
永久的；不断的；无休止的
en: very large in size or amount and seeming to have no end
ex: endless patience
无限的耐心

zh: 永久的；不断的；无休止的
en: in a way that continues for a long time and seems to have no end
ex: She talks endlessly about her problems.
她喋喋不休地谈论着自己的问题。

en: a note printed at the end of a book or section of a book
relating to glands that put hormones and other products directly into the blood
ex: the endocrine system
内分泌系统

en: a doctor who studies the endocrine system and hormones
the branch of medicine that is the study of the endocrine system and hormones

zh: 族内婚，内婚制（只在一个群体内部通婚的风俗）
en: the custom of marrying only people from your local community
having a cause that is inside itself
ex: Money is endogenous to the economy.
金钱是经济的内生因素。
